case_name: A 10-second product ad with a closing line (the live bench's film brief)
title: Cabin Coffee, 10 s YouTube ad
tests: Tests a short ad from a one-line brief: a staged product moment, a human action, and an exact closing line on screen.

faults.what: The main sequence shows a second mug tilted over the table mug, initially pouring into it, rather than clearly showing the table mug being picked up.
The end card switches to a different, light-coloured plaid mug and a grey-sleeved hand, breaking continuity with the dark mug and bare arm.
The supplied audio transcript reports an unrelated spoken utterance, "شايبوسي.", which does not support the requested coffee message.

judge.summary: A warm coffee spot with the correct branded closing line, but an unrequested two-mug pouring sequence replaces the intended simple pickup.

must_haves.item: A steaming mug on a wooden table in dawn light is the opening image.
must_haves.why: The opening sample shows a mug on a wooden table, visible steam, and warm early-morning-style window light, although a second mug is already being tipped above it.
A hand holds a mug raised above the table, including in the closing image, though a continuous pickup of the opening table mug is not shown.

must_haves.item: The words 'Wake up slow' appear on screen at the end, spelled exactly.
must_haves.why: The closing card clearly reads "Wake up slow".

must_haves.item: The mood is warm and quiet (no fast cuts, no loud colours).
must_haves.why: The supplied frames use warm light, muted colours, and a restrained composition, with the same kitchen setup maintained across the first three samples.
The clip is reported as 10.7 seconds and the supplied frames are widescreen 16:9.
